dedupe_keys.name: jr東日本盛岡支社 gtfs transit data

description: JR東日本盛岡支社: GTFS transit data is a dataset listed in Mobility Database, a catalogue of GTFS and GTFS Realtime transit feeds, published or maintained by JR東日本盛岡支社. Public transport schedule data (routes, stops, trips and stop times in the General Transit Feed Specification) for Imabetsu, Aomori Prefecture, Japan. Coverage: Imabetsu, Aomori Prefecture, Japan. The Mobility Database lists 2 GTFS schedule feeds for this provider (Imabetsu, Aomori Prefecture, Japan). The schedule feeds declare these GTFS features: Fares V1, Feed Information, Headsigns, Location Types, Translations. At least one feed is marked as published by the operator itself. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, accessibility and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-mobility-database-mobilitydata.
